panels.title: Database growth (cumulative rows)
panels.description: Running total of rows per device table.

targets.queryText: SELECT * FROM (WITH b AS (SELECT CAST(received_at/60 AS INT)*60 AS time, COUNT(*) AS c FROM "device_ESP32_left" GROUP BY 1) SELECT time, SUM(c) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "ESP32_left" FROM b) WHERE time BETWEEN ($__from / 1000) AND ($__to / 1000) ORDER BY time
